facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports that Malawi's Ministry of ICT has proposed a Government Data Sharing Regulation (a draft regulation, not yet in force) to govern the National Data Exchange Platform, Boma Lathu; the report is dated 2026-06-11 and gives no earlier date for the proposal.

The ICT Minister is quoted saying government institutions still share citizen data by email, USB drives and paper, and that a binding regulation on exchange through the platform is the missing piece, so no instrument in force yet requires data exchange; the report is dated 2026-06-11.
